{{Short description|FIFA World Cup group}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=December 2025}}
{{Use American English|date=November 2025}}
Group B of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] took place from June 12 to 24, 2026.<ref name="match schedule">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/1be9ce37eb98fcc5/original/FWC26-Match-Schedule_English.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 26 – Match Schedule |publisher=[[FIFA]] |date=February 4, 2024 |access-date=February 4, 2024}}</ref> The group consisted of [[Canada men's national soccer team|Canada]] (co-host), [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]], [[Qatar national football team|Qatar]], and [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]]. This also marked the return of Bosnia and Herzegovina to the World Cup finals, with the Bosnians making their first appearance since [[2014 FIFA World Cup|2014]].

Switzerland began their World Cup campaign with a draw, and would go on to top the group after winning their next two group games. Canada finished as runners-up, thanks to their first ever World Cup win against Qatar, and both teams advanced to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage|round of 32]].

Bosnia and Herzegovina finished in third based on goal difference, and their performance secured them as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|eight best third-place teams]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations |publisher=FIFA |date=May 2025 |access-date=June 7, 2025 |archive-date=June 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250623212158/https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |url-status=live}}</ref> allowing them to progress to the round of 32. Qatar finished fourth after losing their second and third group games, which resulted in their elimination.

==Standings==
{{2026 FIFA World Cup group tables|Group B}}

In the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]]:<ref name="regulations"/>
* The winner of Group B, [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]], advanced to play the third-place team of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group J|Group J]], [[Algeria national football team|Algeria]].
* The runner-up of Group B, [[Canada men's national soccer team|Canada]], advanced to play the runner-up of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group A|Group A]], [[South Africa national soccer team|South Africa]].
* The third-place team of Group B, [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]], advanced to play the winner of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group D|Group D]], the [[United States men's national soccer team|United States]], as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|eight best third-place teams]] from the group stage.

==Matches==
All times listed are local.<ref name="match schedule"/>

===Canada vs Bosnia and Herzegovina=== 
The two teams had never met before. This was the first senior men's World Cup match played in Canada.<ref>{{cite news |last=Bonetti |first=Matteo |title=4 Takeaways From Canada's World Cup Opener vs. Bosnia And Herzegovina|url=https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/canada-vs-bosnia-herzegovina-4-takeaways-world-cup-opener|access-date= 13 June 2026 |work=[[Fox Sports]]|date= 13 June 2026}}</ref>

Bosnia took the lead in the 21st minute when [[Jovo Lukić]] headed into the net from close range after [[Sead Kolašinac]] had flicked on [[Ivan Bašić]]'s corner from the right. In the 78th minute it was 1–1 when substitute [[Cyle Larin]] scored with a deflected shot to the right of the net.

With a 1–1 draw, this marked the first time that Canada won a point at a World Cup, after they had been beaten in all three games in 1986 and then again in 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c1dy55edn2yt#Report|title= Canada 1 Bosnia-Herzegovina 1|date=12 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=15 June 2026}}</ref>

===Qatar vs Switzerland===
The teams previously met in a 2018 friendly, which ended in a 1–0 win for Qatar.<ref>{{cite web|title=Qatar national football team: record v Switzerland|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/qatar/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Switzerland|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 5, 2025}}</ref>

In the 17th minute, Switzerland were awarded a penalty when [[Remo Freuler]] was fouled by the diving Qatar goalkeeper [[Mahmud Abunada]]. Television replays appeared to show Freuler had strayed marginally offside in the build-up but the penalty was awarded and was scored by [[Breel Embolo]] with a low finish to the left. In the 94th minute, Qatar scored an equalizer when Switzerland defender [[Miro Muheim]] under pressure from [[Boualem Khoukhi]], headed a Homam Ahmed cross from the left past his own goalkeeper to the right of the net with the match finishing 1–1.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c4gy0jy8dglt|title= Qatar 1 Switzerland 1|date=13 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=16 June 2026}}</ref>

This was the first time Qatar earned a point at the World Cup, after losing three consecutive matches as the host nation in 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rte.ie/sport/soccer/2026/0613/1578295-world-cup-2026-qatar-v-switzerland-updates/|title= World Cup 2026: Qatar 1–1 Switzerland recap|date=13 June 2026|work=RTE Sport|accessdate=16 June 2026}}</ref>

===Switzerland vs Bosnia and Herzegovina===
[[File:2026 FIFA World Cup Match 26, Switzerland v Bosnia and Herzegovina.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Midway in the Switzerland vs Bosnia and Herzegovina match]]
The teams had only met in a 2016 friendly, which ended in a 2–0 win for Bosnia.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/bosnia-and-herzegovina/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Switzerland/|title=Bosnia And Herzegovina national football team: record v Switzerland|website=11v11.com}}</ref>

===Canada vs Qatar===
[[File:Jonathan David Mahmud Abunada Canada v Qatar 18 June 2026-227.jpg|thumb|right|[[Jonathan David]] scoring one of his three goals, becoming the second North American player to score a World Cup [[List of FIFA World Cup hat-tricks|hat-trick]].]]
The teams previously faced each other once in 2022, a friendly won 2–0 by Canada.<ref>{{cite web|title=Canada national football team: record v Qatar|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/canada/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Qatar|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 5, 2025}}</ref>

This was the first World Cup match won by Canada in its history, and the biggest winning margin by a nation outside of [[UEFA]] or [[CONMEBOL]] in World Cup history.

Additionally, [[Jonathan David]] became the first North American player to score a World Cup [[List of FIFA World Cup hat-tricks|hat-trick]] since [[Bert Patenaude]] did so for the [[United States men's national soccer team|United States]] against [[Paraguay national football team|Paraguay]] in [[1930 FIFA World Cup|1930]], and the first player to score a World Cup hat-trick on home soil since [[Geoff Hurst]] did so for [[England national football team|England]] against West Germany in the [[1966 FIFA World Cup Final|1966 final]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sportstar |first=Team |date=2026-06-19 |title=Jonathan David levels two unique records with hat-trick in Canada vs Qatar at FIFA World Cup 2026 |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/football/fifa-world-cup/jonathan-david-hattrick-sets-two-new-records-canada-vs-qatar-fifa-world-cup-2026/article71120505.ece |access-date=2026-06-19 |website=Sportstar |language=en}}</ref> He also became the second player to score a hat-trick in the tournament, after [[Lionel Messi]] did so in [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group J#Argentina vs Algeria|Argentina's opening match against Algeria]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=19 June 2026 |title=Jonathan David Hat Trick Fires Canada To Historic 6-0 World Cup Win Over Qatar |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/jonathan-david-hat-trick-fires-011914876.html |work=[[Yahoo Sports]]}}</ref>

===Switzerland vs Canada===
[[File:2026 FIFA World Cup - Switzerland vs. Canada pre match 02.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pre-match ceremony between [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]] and [[Canada men's national soccer team|Canada]].]]
The teams' only meeting took place in 2002, a friendly won 3–1 by Canada.<ref>{{cite web|title=Switzerland national football team: record v Canada|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/switzerland/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Canada|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 5, 2025}}</ref>

With this fixture, co-hosts Canada finished as Group B runners-up behind Switzerland, who secured the top spot after handing the Canadians their only defeat. A day later, fellow co-hosts the United States also suffered a setback, [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group D#Turkey vs United States|losing 3–2]] to already-eliminated Turkey in Group D in Los Angeles. This leaves Mexico as the only co-host to remain undefeated, having won all of their group stage matches.

The loss forced Canada to play against [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group A|Group A]] runners-up [[South Africa national soccer team|South Africa]] outside of its borders for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup round of 32#South Africa vs Canada|round of 32]] in Los Angeles, as failing to top the group cost them a guaranteed spot on [[Home advantage|home soil]], a match which was also played in Vancouver.

===Bosnia and Herzegovina vs Qatar===
[[File:Bosnia-Herzeg 3 - 1 Qatar Group B.jpg|thumb|right|Pre-match ceremony between [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and [[Qatar national football team|Qatar]]]]

The teams had met twice: Qatar won 2–0 in 2000, and their most recent meeting was a 1–1 draw in 2010.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bosnia & Herzegovina vs Qatar H2H Results |url=https://eu-football.info/_matches.php?id=26&oppo=162 |website=eu-football.info |access-date=3 April 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

Bosnia and Herzegovina's three-goal victory secured their first-ever spot in the round of 32. Meanwhile, Qatar was eliminated from the group stage for the second consecutive World Cup, following their [[2022 FIFA World Cup|2022]] exit as hosts.

==Discipline==
The team conduct ("fair play") score would have been used as a tiebreaker if the head-to-head and overall records of teams were tied. It would also be used as a tiebreaker for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|third-place ranking]] between groups if the overall records of teams were tied. The score was calculated based on yellow and red cards received by players and team officials in all group matches as follows:<ref name="regulations"/>
*yellow card: −1 point;
*indirect red card (second yellow card): −3 points;
*direct red card: −4 points;
*yellow card and direct red card: −5 points;

Only one of the above deductions could be applied to a player or team official in a single match.
